brief:
Gaza's government media office director warned that more than 60 percent of tents housing displaced residents have deteriorated and require urgent replacement, Shehab Wire reported. Ismail al-Thawabta cautioned that the approaching winter threatens severe humanitarian consequences for hundreds of thousands of displaced people across the territory.

The deterioration of shelter infrastructure compounds existing challenges as cold weather approaches, raising concerns about conditions in displacement camps throughout Gaza.

title: Over 60% of Gaza displacement camps need immediate tent replacement
